description.value: Tandoori Flame is a large-format Indian buffet restaurant chain claiming the title of North America's Largest Indian Buffet, with the Surrey-Delta location being the newest addition to the family, opening in 2020. Guests can choose from up to 150 items across 12 live cooking stations, with an emphasis on made-from-scratch dishes using fresh local produce and freshly ground Indian spices. The restaurant also offers takeout and catering, and can host private parties for groups of 20 to over 300.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Surrey-Delta location of Tandoori Flame at 11970 88 Ave, Delta, BC with phone (778) 578-7777, matching OSM exactly. OSM tags confirm takeaway=yes and diet:vegetarian=yes; the website corroborates both with a dedicated Take Away page and a 150-item buffet marketed as having 'something for everyone.' No evidence appears anywhere in the website or OSM tags for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenities.
concerns: No evidence found for bike parking, water refill, or washrooms — all required WWC criteria are unverified and will need field confirmation before a full listing is published.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-established restaurant with confirmed takeout and vegetarian options — a practical food stop for touring cyclists in Delta. Bike parking and other cycling-specific amenities are unverified and should be confirmed via field visit.
enrichment_extras.notes: Multi-location chain (Brampton ON, Mississauga ON, Surrey-Delta BC). OSM record and website are consistent for the Surrey-Delta location. Catering inquiries for BC go to a separate phone number: (778) 697-5755.
